definitions.semantic_scope: Same-input cells require equal named masses and the full nonnegative orthant; cross-input equality uses mass-weighted relative-row measures; the executable selector bridge uses proper-CNF list syntax and duplicate-free one-two rows.
definitions.semantic_withdrawal_condition: The relation cells require their declared ledger and weight-domain contracts. The conventional class corollary is unavailable without an explicit ExecutableCNFConventionalBoundary.
